netlist:
C Cin VIN1 n1
NMOS M1 n2 n1 n3 VSS
R Rs n3 VSS
R R1 n2 VDD
NMOS M2 n4 n2 n3 VSS
R R2 n4 VDD
C Cfb n4 n1
R Rs3 n3 VSS
NMOS M3 n5 n2 n3 VSS
C Cout n4 VOUT1
rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints—particularly NF and S21—by adding a source-degenerated NMOS (M3) with a resistor (Rs3) to increase input impedance and reduce noise gain, while maintaining a low-noise path through the primary amplifier stage. This enhances input matching (S11) and improves transducer gain (S21) by increasing the effective input resistance, while the degeneration reduces noise figure by lowering the transconductance gain and thus minimizing the noise contribution from the input stage. The topology remains inductorless and fits within the device budget and sizing constraints.
